actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected complete portrait card. Image1 is the exact rejected full-resolution generated PNG editing target; Image2 is the unchanged original small card, sole authority for source-visible pose, hair, expression, clothes, crop and light; Image3 supplies mascot identity and compact near-round head anatomy only.
Correct ONLY the excessive vertical elongation of the yellow head/lower face and its collar fit. Image1 currently has a long vertical oval with a large stretched yellow region below the mouth. Replace that with ONE COMPACT NEAR-ROUND mascot head, visually about as tall as it is broad, with a smoothly ROUNDED short chin close below the closed mouth. Broaden the lower cheek/head silhouette and shorten the stretched lower face; raise and broaden the existing dark garment neckline to meet the round chin directly, with only a tiny very short broad transition. The original human face was long, but that human aspect ratio must NOT override the mascot anatomy. Do not merely hide a long yellow stalk under a narrow collar, and do not crop off the head to conceal the defect. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, neck rolls, pinching, floating collar, clipping or cream belly bib.
Preserve exactly one person, actual near-frontal mild source head angle and the strong IMAGE-LEFT face shadow with IMAGE-RIGHT highlights. Retain short dark brown/black swept-back side-part hair and real brow hair, green-ringed black eyes, serious CLOSED mascot mouth, smooth upper lip/chin with no moustache or beard. Keep the limited DARK outer garment/neckline actually exposed at lower left; its fine lapel/shirt/tie structure is obscured in Image2, so do not invent a bright shirt, tie, uniform or decorations. Preserve original framing, photographic crop, the complete tilted dark frame, OPAQUE GREY-GREEN backing and lower-right cream note with faint indistinct marks and original overlap. All internal skin, hair, dark cloth, backing and note remain fully opaque; alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. No extra people, readable writing, symbols, labels, watermark or comparison sheet.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
